verdict: Only with a clear niche. Watchout Wearables from Thane pitched smartwatches on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Smartwatches are a crowded market where Noise, boAt and Fire-Boltt compete hard on price.
angle: Smartwatch sales have slowed after years of fast growth. Niches such as kids' safety watches, elder care or sports tracking have less competition. Software and app quality decide reviews.
